$comment: The exact third-party source that is compiled into wasm/dist/pubshift.wasm.
This file exists because MPL-2.0 section 3.2(a) obliges anyone who distributes
Covered Software in Executable Form to make the corresponding Source Code Form
available. Serving pubshift.wasm from a web page IS distributing it in Executable
Form. An offer of source that does not say *which* source is not an offer, so the
pin below is exact and machine-checkable.
tools/licence/fetch-sources.sh reads this file, fetches each component and verifies
it against the recorded commit/digest. tools/licence/make-source-offer.sh turns the
verified tree into the tarball that must be published next to the binary.
If you change what the build compiles, change this file in the same commit.

components.name: libmspub
components.role: Parses the Publisher file format. This is the part that makes the product possible.
components.linkage: All of src/lib/*.cpp are compiled into pubshift.wasm.
components.modificationNote: No file of libmspub is edited. The build supplies its own config.h (wasm/config/libmspub/config.h) in place of the autotools-generated one, and its own <unicode/*.h> (wasm/include/unicode/) in place of ICU. Both are new files of ours, not changes to libmspub, so they are not Modifications under MPL-2.0 section 1.10 — but they are needed to reproduce the binary and are therefore included in the source offer.

components.name: librevenge
components.role: The document-interchange layer libmspub calls back into, plus the OLE2 stream reader.
components.linkage: Eleven translation units are compiled in: RVNGBinaryData, RVNGMemoryStream, RVNGProperty, RVNGPropertyList, RVNGPropertyListVector, RVNGString, RVNGStringVector, RVNGStreamImplementation, RVNGDirectoryStream, RVNGOLEStream, RVNGZipStream. The upstream generators (HTML/CSV/SVG/raw/text) are not compiled in.
components.modificationNote: Unedited. Built against wasm/config/librevenge/config.h instead of the autotools-generated one.

components.name: zlib
components.role: Inflates the compressed streams inside a .pub file. Pulled in by emscripten's -sUSE_ZLIB=1, not vendored here.
components.obligationNote: The zlib licence imposes no notice requirement on binary distribution; clause 2 says acknowledgement 'is appreciated but is not required'. Credited anyway.

source.note: The exact version is whatever the emscripten in use pins. wasm/dist/SOURCES.txt records the emscripten version of the build that produced the shipped binary.

components.name: Boost (headers only)
components.role: Header-only utilities libmspub includes. Pulled in by emscripten's --use-port=boost_headers.
components.obligationNote: BSL-1.0 explicitly exempts copies that are 'solely in the form of machine-executable object code generated by a source language processor' from the notice requirement. pubshift.wasm is exactly that. Credited anyway.

components.name: Emscripten runtime, libc++ and musl-derived libc
components.role: The C++ standard library and the JS glue in wasm/dist/pubshift.mjs.
components.licence: MIT AND (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception) AND NCSA
components.obligationNote: MIT and Apache-2.0 both require the licence text and copyright notice to accompany binary distribution. Carried in public/licences/.

components.name: ICU character-conversion data (derived)
components.role: wasm/icu_shim_data.inc holds codepage tables and LCID mappings dumped out of a real ICU so the shim reproduces ICU's answers rather than approximating them. The tables are derived from ICU data; no ICU code is linked.
components.obligationNote: The Unicode licence requires the copyright and permission notice to appear with copies of the data and in supporting documentation. Carried in public/licences/ and credited on the /credits page.

source.note: Regenerate with wasm/tools/gen-icu-data.py against the same icu4c the native oracle links.

components.modificationNote: Reformatted from an ICU dump into C++ array literals. The values are ICU's.

ourCode.note: Everything under native/, wasm/api.cpp, wasm/icu_shim.*, wasm/config/, wasm/include/, packages/ and apps/ is ours and is MPL-2.0 to match libmspub.
